configuration.enabledFormats.markdownDes:
Configure which variable naming conventions are enabled.

[Configure conversion order](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22variable-conversion.formatOrder%22%5D)    [View current configuration](command:variable-conversion.showConvertCaseDetailDialog)    [Edit in settings.json](command:workbench.action.openSettingsJson)
configuration.enabledFormats.spaceCase.d:

🌰 `mike like eat ice cream`

🌰 `MIKE LIKE EAT ICE CREAM`
configuration.enabledFormats.spacePascal:

configuration.enabledFormats.spaceCamelC:

configuration.formatOrder.markdownDescri:
Configure the display order of variable naming conventions.

If a format is disabled in `#variable-conversion.enabledFormats#`, it will not be shown even if it appears in this list.

When editing `settings.json`, make sure the format names match those in `enabledFormats`.

🌰 e.g. `["camel_case", "snake_case", "pascal_case"]`

[Configure enabled formats](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22variable-conversion.enabledFormats%22%5D)    [View current configuration](command:variable-conversion.showConvertCaseDetailDialog)    [Edit in settings.json](command:workbench.action.openSettingsJson)
